spells.notes: 전두환-era minister in office on 1988-02-25 (caretaker holdover). Appointed in the 1987-05-26 개각 and given the 임명장 that afternoon (동아일보 1987-05-26). He was not reappointed in the 1987-07-13 개각, where only the six outgoing ministers submitted resignations (중앙일보 1987-07-14 "10분간격으로 사표제출", BigKinds 01100901.19870714194835009, search snapshot roster/sources/finance/ext88/news/bk_t0c_jul1987_kaegak.json). The whole 김정렬 cabinet submitted resignations after the last 국무회의 on 1988-02-24, and 노태우 accepted them on the morning of 1988-02-25 (조선일보 1988-02-26, 중앙일보 1988-02-25). He was reappointed by 노태우 the same day at 11:40 (next spell). The spell is split there because the retained ministers received new 임명장, which the press called 재기용 rather than 유임 (동아일보 1988-02-19). 헌법 제10호 부칙 제4조① deems officials in office on 1988-02-25 appointed under the new constitution, so he was in office on 1988-02-25 until the acceptance. ko.wikipedia shows one continuous tenure 1987-05-26..1988-12-04. Birth date 1940-01-10 from ko.wikipedia "사공일" https://ko.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?oldid=41069091 (accessed 2026-09-26T09:04:14-0400; snapshot roster/sources/finance/ext88/wiki/wiki_사공일_41069091.json), whose category list files him under 1939년 출생 (a conflict inside the page). Wikidata P569 is 1940-01-10. Gender from Wikidata Q18328764 P21 = male (accessed 2026-09-26T09:49:43-0400; snapshot roster/sources/finance/ext88/wiki/wikidata_entities.json). [verifier] 매일경제 1988-02-25 (an evening paper) confirms that 노태우 accepted the 5th Republic cabinet's resignations on the morning of 02-25 before giving the new 임명장, and that the cabinet took office 'as of that date' (이날짜로 정식발족).

spells.notes: Named as a 재기용 minister on 1988-02-19 and given a new 임명장 by 노태우 at 11:40 on 1988-02-25 with the rest of the first 제6공화국 cabinet (경향신문 and 서울신문 of 1988-02-26). 중앙일보 1988-02-25 counts 23 new 국무위원 besides the PM and 조선일보 1988-02-26 counts 24, both including the seven retained ministers. Replaced in the 1988-12-05 전면개각. That morning the 이현재 cabinet submitted resignations en bloc and the new ministers received 임명장 at 16:00 (경향신문 1988-12-05, 한국일보 1988-12-06). No separate exit date was found, so the end is the successor's appointment day. ko.wikipedia gives 1988-12-04 as the last day. spells.notes: Announced on 1990-03-17 (the 3.17 개각) and given the 임명장 on the morning of 1990-03-19. 조선일보 1990-03-18 quotes a new minister saying he had not yet received the 임명장. The start is the 임명장 date, as in finance.verified.json for 이헌재 2000 (announced 2000-01-13, 임명장 2000-01-14) and in the ministry pages that print day-level dates for this reshuffle (msit, mohw, mois, moj: 1990-03-19). Hence start_confidence medium. Replaced in the partial reshuffle announced on the afternoon of 1991-05-26, and the successor received his 임명장 on the morning of 1991-05-27. No ko.wikipedia article or Wikidata item was found for him. 경향신문 1990-03-17 gives his age as 53 and his origin as 慶南 河東, so the birth date is left null. Gender is not stated in the sources read and is left null. [verifier] Gender set to M. The appointment profiles name his wife (부인 김순자씨, 동아일보 1990-03-17 p.4, 한국일보 1990-03-18, 국민일보 1990-03-17, listed in verification.changes). No birth date was found in those profiles, so birth_date stays as it was.

spells.notes: Announced on the afternoon of 1991-05-26 (한겨레 1991-05-28 says 임명·발령 that day) and given the 임명장 on the morning of 1991-05-27. The start is the 임명장 date (motir and moj pages also start this reshuffle on 1991-05-27), hence start_confidence medium. Stayed in office after 노태우's term ended at midnight on 1993-02-24. 매일경제 1993-02-24 reports the 총무처 view that the outgoing ministers had no fixed term, needed no en bloc resignation and would hand over when the new ministers were appointed, and 한겨레 1993-02-26 interviewed him on 02-25 as a minister '퇴임을 하루 앞둔'. Other outgoing ministers held 이임식 on 1993-02-26 (동아일보 1993-02-26, 조선일보 and 경향신문 1993-02-27). The end is therefore the day the 김영삼 cabinet was appointed, 1993-02-26. 중앙일보 1993-02-25 says instead that the outgoing cabinet submitted resignations on 02-25 and all were accepted, which would make 02-25 the last day. ko.wikipedia gives 1993-02-24. Birth year 1933 from ko.wikipedia "이용만 (1933년)" https://ko.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?oldid=41920793 (accessed 2026-09-26T09:04:16-0400). Wikidata Q112022940 also has the year only. Gender is not stated in the sources read and is left null. [verifier] Gender set to M. The appointment profiles name his wife (부인 주경순씨, 세계일보 1991-05-28, 국민일보 1991-05-27, 한국일보 1991-05-27, listed in verification.changes). No birth date was found in those profiles, so birth_date stays as it was. [verifier] End 1993-02-26 re-checked with sources the builder did not cite. 한겨레 1993-02-26 p.6 says the economic ministers, 이용만 among them, all left office on the 26th, and 국민일보 1993-02-27 describes the outgoing ministries' farewell ceremonies on the morning of the 26th. The 중앙일보 1993-02-25 report of resignations accepted on the 25th stays the only contrary source found.

spells.notes: First 부총리 겸 재정경제원장관. He was 부총리 겸 경제기획원장관 (epb lineage) when 경제기획원 and 재무부 were merged into 재정경제원 on 1994-12-23 (법률 제4831호). 김영삼 kept him on (유임) in the 1994-12-23 개각, but 부칙 제2조① moves only the duties and the non-정무직 staff, so a new appointment was needed. The 임명장 was given on the morning of 1994-12-24 and his 취임식 at 재정경제원 was held the same day. The start is the 임명장 date (ministry pages of other ministries also start this reshuffle on 1994-12-24), hence start_confidence medium. ko.wikipedia gives 1994-12-23. reorg_continuation is true because his tenure as economic 부총리 continued through the merger, but the previous spell is in the epb lineage, not in this file (the last 재무부장관 was 박재윤). 1994-12-23 is a one-day vacancy of the new office. Replaced in the reshuffle announced on 1995-12-20. The successor received the 임명장 at 09:00 on 1995-12-21, so the end is the successor's start (ko.wikipedia gives 1995-12-20). Birth date 1938-03-27 from ko.wikipedia "홍재형" https://ko.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?oldid=42394707 (accessed 2026-09-26T09:04:17-0400; snapshot roster/sources/finance/ext88/wiki/wiki_홍재형_42394707.json). Gender from Wikidata Q16093141 P21 = male (accessed 2026-09-26T09:49:43-0400; snapshot roster/sources/finance/ext88/wiki/wikidata_entities.json). [verifier] end_reason corrected to resigned_to_run. The press named him from 1995-12-01 on as a certain 15대 총선 candidate for 청주, the 12-20 reshuffle replaced him for that reason, and he ran for 신한국당 in 청주 상당 on 1996-04-11 and lost (동아일보 1995-12-18, 조선일보 1995-12-18, 한겨레 1995-12-19, 동아일보 1995-12-21 and 1996-03-28, 한겨레 and 매일경제 1996-04-12). He held his farewell on 12-20, and the end stays at the successor's 임명장 on 12-21 as in finance.verified.json for 강봉균 2000. The 1996-03-28 동아일보 story reports his 58th birthday on 1996-03-27, which agrees with the birth date 1938-03-27.

issues.desc: Start-date convention. When a reshuffle was announced on one day and the 임명장 given the next, the start is the 임명장 date, as in finance.verified.json for 이헌재 (announced 2000-01-13, 임명장 2000-01-14) and as the gazette shows after 2001. This affects 정영의 1990-03-19 (announced 03-17), 이용만 1991-05-27 (05-26), 박재윤 1994-10-05 (10-04), 홍재형 1994-12-24 (12-23), 나웅배 1995-12-21 (12-20), 한승수 1996-08-09 (08-08) and 강경식 1997-03-06 (03-05), all with start_confidence medium. The predecessors' ends move with them. The day-level ministry pages of other ministries follow the same convention for 1990-03, 1991-05, 1994-12, 1995-12 and 1997-03, but the msit page dates the 1996-08 appointments 1996-08-08. ko.wikipedia mostly uses the announcement date. Other 1988-1998 lineages should apply one convention, and the assembler should check this.

1988-02-25 split. All 전두환-era ministers submitted resignations on 1988-02-24 (동아일보 1988-02-24), 노태우 accepted them on the morning of 1988-02-25 (조선일보 1988-02-26, 중앙일보 1988-02-25), and the seven retained ministers, 사공일 among them, received new 임명장 at 11:40 that day with the rest of the cabinet (경향신문 1988-02-26, 조선일보 1988-02-26 counts 24 new 국무위원). 동아일보 1988-02-19 reports the view that a retained minister's term ended at 00:00 on 1988-02-25 and that he received a new 임명장, so the press called it 재기용 rather than 유임. 사공일 therefore has two spells, 1987-05-26..1988-02-25 (전두환, end_reason resigned) and 1988-02-25..1988-12-05 (노태우). Other lineages with retained ministers (외무 최광수, 내무 이상희, 법무 정해창, 체육 조상호, 건설 최동섭, 체신 오명) face the same choice.

1993-02 end of the 노태우 cabinet. 이용만's end is 1993-02-26, the day the 김영삼 cabinet was appointed. 매일경제 1993-02-24 gives the 총무처 view that no en bloc resignation was needed, 한겨레 1993-02-26 describes him on 02-25 as one day before leaving office, and other outgoing ministers held 이임식 on 02-26. 중앙일보 1993-02-25 (BigKinds 01100901.19930225151908002) says instead that the outgoing cabinet submitted resignations on 02-25 and all were accepted, which would make 1993-02-25 the last day. end_confidence medium. The same question applies to every 노태우-era holdover in other lineages.

One-day vacancy on 1994-12-23 between the end of 재무부 (last day 1994-12-22 per offices_1988.json) and the 임명장 of 부총리 겸 재정경제원장관 홍재형 on 1994-12-24. No acting head was found. The 재무부 end follows the convention used for 임창열 in 1998 (office's last day), although 박재윤 was legally in office until the promulgation on 1994-12-23.

홍재형's 1994-12-24 spell has reorg_continuation true and reappointed_on_reorg true because he continued as the economic 부총리 through the merger with a new 임명장. His preceding spell (부총리 겸 경제기획원장관 1994-10-05..) is in the epb lineage, so the assembler will not join it to a finance spell. His 재무부 spell 1993-02-26..1994-10-05 is a separate spell in this file.

ko.wikipedia (list revision 41712447) differs from this file in several places. It has 사공일 as one continuous tenure (split here at 1988-02-25), 이규성 end 1990-03-18 (here 03-19), 정영의 end 1991-05-26 (here 05-27), 이용만 end 1993-02-24 (here 02-26), 홍재형 start 1993-02-25 (news shows 02-26), 홍재형 end 1994-10-04 (here 10-05), 박재윤 end 1994-12-23 (here 12-22 by the office convention), 홍재형 재정경제원 start 1994-12-23 (here 12-24), 나웅배 1995-12-20 (here 12-21), 한승수 1996-08-08 (here 08-09), 강경식 1997-03-05 (here 03-06).

Personal data gaps. 정영의 has no ko.wikipedia article or Wikidata item. His birth date and gender are null (경향신문 1990-03-17 gives age 53). 이용만 has birth year 1933 only and no gender source. 사공일's ko.wikipedia page gives 1940-01-10 in the infobox but files him under 1939년 출생. Wikidata also gives 1940-01-10, which is used. Birth dates are secondary sources.

No PM 직무대행 by the 재정경제원 부총리 (first in the acting order from 1994-12-23) was found for 1994-12-23..1998-02-24.
